title: Extra Creamy Veracruzan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A delicious Mexican-inspired dish featuring a perfectly melted cheese blend, fresh fennel, and a hint of reduction for an indulgent midnight craving.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the sliced fennel until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, mix together queso fresco, Monterey Jack cheese, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with the cheese mixture.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla starts to brown.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese mixture.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with a dollop of sour cream and additional fennel slices, if desired.
